enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Combat Mastery +5: +5 Insight bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Strength +13: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Vertigo +15: This effect gives a +15 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip and Improved Trip attempts.
Quality Vertigo +3: This effect gives a +3 Quality bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip and Improved Trip attempts.
Mythic Boot Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
